entries.2424d38eacb6f3c9: The company has set its purpose as “bringing ‘excitement’ to life through the power of connecting people and technology” and aims for the vision of “an excellent company co-creating the future.” In the medium- to long-term management plan “ONE RYODEN Growth 2029 | 2034,” launched in fiscal 2025, the company is advancing its transformation into a business creation company, and it positions fiscal 2026 as the transition year to a “monetization and expansion phase.” To propose company-wide solutions that combine the strengths of each business division, it newly established the “SI Business Promotion Office.”

entries.77bb20ca95f6c37c: Its foundation is its track record of handling Mitsubishi Electric products since it was founded in 1947 as an agency of Mitsubishi Electric. It has sales agency and exclusive dealer agreements with Mitsubishi Electric, which is the main supplier for the FA Systems Business and the Cooling and Building Systems Business, while it also sells components and other items to that company. It handles a wide range of products, from FA equipment to air-conditioning equipment and semiconductors, and within the group it has a subsidiary responsible for maintenance services as well as sales subsidiaries in Asia, North America and Europe.
entries.7c2c371c4cf41af7: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external net sales were Electronics ¥117,471 million, accounting for more than half of the total, FA Systems ¥50,023 million, Cooling and Building Systems ¥36,779 million, and X-Tech ¥8,496 million. By customer location, Japan accounted for the large majority at ¥162,614 million, followed by Asia at ¥27,615 million, North America at ¥15,833 million and Europe at ¥5,417 million.
